fundamentals.name: Arm Holdings plc
fundamentals.longBusinessSummary: Arm Holdings plc researches, develops, licenses, and markets central processing unit (CPU) intellectual property (IP), graphics processing unit IP, systems IP, compute subsystems (CSS), and associated software, tools and related services. The company provides a product portfolio, including CPU IP, GPU and neural processing unit (NPU) accelerators, system IP such as interconnects, compute platform products including pre-integrated CSSs, and development tools and software. The company serves semiconductor companies, original equipment manufacturers (OEMs), cloud service providers (CSPs), and organizations developing chips for end markets such as smartphones, consumer electronics, industrial IoT, embedded systems, cloud data centers, networking, automotive, and robotics. It provides its products and services in the United States, China, Japan, Taiwan, Korea, and internationally. The company was founded in 1990 and is based in Cambridge, United Kingdom. Arm Holdings plc operates as a subsidiary of SoftBank Group Corp.

judgment.summary: Arm Holdings exhibits strong growth and margins but carries a very high valuation and significant debt relative to its cash position.
judgment.earningsRecap: Last reported quarter (ending 2026-03-31) EPS was $0.60, beating estimates by 3.6%; next earnings date is 2026-07-29.
positives: Revenue growth 20.1% YoY and earnings growth 47.9% YoY indicate strong top-line and bottom-line expansion.
Gross margin of 97.5% and operating margin of 29.5% demonstrate exceptional profitability on its core business.
Quarterly earnings growth of 49.0% and analyst estimates for current Q and FY show continued positive momentum.
Strong liquidity with a current ratio of 6.00 and quick ratio of 5.83, supported by $3.60B in cash.
Analyst consensus is a buy with a mean target of $257.30, suggesting upside potential despite recent price drops.
negatives: Trailing P/E of 428.49 and Forward P/E of 120.12 indicate an extremely high valuation.
Debt/Equity ratio of 5.93 is substantial, raising concerns about financial leverage.
The FTC probe into its licensing model and AGI CPU plans presents regulatory risk.
Beta of 3.79 suggests high volatility relative to the broader market.
Analyst mean target of $257.30 is significantly below the current spot price of $368.50.

news.paragraph: Arm Holdings has seen significant volatility recently, shedding 25% of its value as the Federal Reserve maintains a hawkish stance, while also facing scrutiny from the FTC regarding its licensing model and AGI CPU plans. Despite this, the company's executives have highlighted a shift toward agentic AI computing alongside NVIDIA, and the stock has seen some upward movement on broader chip sector strength and geopolitical news. The recent price action suggests a battle between fundamental concerns and AI-driven optimism.
